summary.text: Gary Deering is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 29 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Gary L. Cammack.
Deering finished first in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, defeating incumbents Kathy Rice and Terri Jorgenson.
